policy: Latest eligible exact-end annual 20-F XBRL observations with 350–370-day durations. Null is not zero. Fiscal years are calendar years. Data must be checked against annual statements for unusual signs/reclassifications. Narrow capital excludes several operating assets and liabilities, taxes and acquired assets; not comprehensive ROIC. No R&D capitalization. Physical depreciation excludes acquired amortization. Return proxy applies a constant23% tax to reported EBIT and average narrow book capital; it excludes acquired goodwill/intangibles and is not a sustainable return estimate. No stock split found in reviewed annual histories; no ADR ratio applied. v2 corrects FY2021–25 diluted-weighted-share scale against primary printed EPS statements; original raw XBRL values are retained. Historical investments_current is an original aggregate short-term investment classification through2021 and null thereafter, not a complete comparable liquid-asset history; use the separately sourced dated capital bridge for valuation.
